answer_text:
Here are some fun and weird habits that many people have — you might even recognize a few of your own! 😄

---

### 🖊️ 1. Doodling During Phone Calls
There are a handful of people who doodle during phone calls to help keep them focused. Sometimes, they don't even know they're doing it until they're off the phone.

---

### 🗣️ 2. Talking to Inanimate Objects
A lot of us have the habit of talking to inanimate objects — like apologizing to a table after accidentally bumping into it, or yelling at a laptop when it decides to freeze right in the middle of something important.

---

### 🚿 3. Rehearsing Arguments in the Shower
The shower seems to be the perfect place to rehearse arguments. The most brilliant comebacks for past conflicts always seem to surface while you're shampooing your hair — long after the moment has passed.

---

### 🗑️ 4. Folding Trash Into Neat Squares
Some people fold their trash — any pieces of paper, foil, chip bags, candy wrappers, or paper towels — folding everything into a neat square once they're done with it.

---

### 🧠 5. Saying "Ow" Before Getting Hurt
Some people say "Ow" when they bang something with another object, even though it didn't actually touch or hurt them. It's like a preemptive pain response!

---

### 😬 6. Midnight Cringe Sessions
Some people find that when they're wide awake at midnight, their brain decides it's the perfect time to remind them of every embarrassing thing they've ever done. Suddenly, they're cringing over something from five years ago.

---

### 📱 7. Scrolling Through Their Own Social Media
Some people scroll through their own Instagram or Facebook profile as if they were their biggest fan — casually going through posts, checking the number of likes, and feeling like a celebrity reading the comments.

---

### 🥦 8. Eating Foods Separately
Some people eat things on their plate completely separately — for example, eating all the chicken before moving on to the broccoli. Many don't even realize it's unusual until someone points it out.

---

### 🐕 9. Telling Objects to "Stay"
Some people tell breakable objects or things they don't want to misplace to "stay" out loud, just like you would to a dog. As one person noted, they never thought it was weird until someone asked if they were afraid it would walk off.

---

### 🥛 10. Shaking Store-Bought Milk
Some people shake milk jugs before pouring — a habit developed from growing up on a dairy farm where it was necessary with fresh milk. One person was about 30 before someone asked why, and they had to stop and realize they didn't need to do it with store-bought milk.

---

### 🍫 11. Whispering the ABCs at Food
Some people whisper the ABCs under their breath at their food — like Oreos. One person's ex stared at them, horrified, and asked why they were "chanting" at the cookies, convinced it was some kind of evil ritual.

---

### 🍫 12. Eating Non-Food Items (Pica)
On a more serious note, some people have a habit of eating non-food items like dirt or chalk, known as pica.

---

As humans, we're all odd in our own ways, but some of our tendencies are more common than you might think! So if you recognized yourself in any of these, you're definitely not alone. 😄
